version: 11.0 — 6 agents, fully AI-PDLC branded, no external methodology references

architecture.orchestrator: AI-PDLC Orchestrator — single user-facing agent. Reads specialist frameworks dynamically at runtime, asks all questions in chat, delegates headless.
architecture.specialists: 5 specialist agents — work standalone (interactive) OR headless (when invoked by Orchestrator)
architecture.dynamic_lookup: Orchestrator finds specialists by name (find_relevant_chat_agents) — no hardcoded IDs

flow.pipeline: Discovery → Prioritize → Working Backwards → Spec Generator → Designer
flow.single_solution: Discovery → Working Backwards → Spec Generator → Designer
flow.multiple_solutions: Discovery → Prioritize → Working Backwards → Spec Generator → Designer
flow.design_options: External (Figma/Miro) OR Internal (AI-PDLC Designer in Quick)

audit_format.description: All specialists produce audit entries. Orchestrator does not write audit — specialists do after artifact generation.
audit_format.template:
📋 AUDIT LOG
Agent: [agent name]
Phase: [phase number] — [name]
Decision: [summary]
Details: [bullets]
Artifact: [filename]
Artifact location: [user-provided space name]
Validated by: [name (alias)]
Evidence: [supporting evidence]
Timestamp: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM IST]
---

agents.name: AI-PDLC Orchestrator
agents.description: Single interface for the entire pipeline. Reads specialist frameworks dynamically, asks questions, delegates headless.
key_behaviors: Delegates via start_task with pre-filled context

agents.name: AI-PDLC Discovery
agents.description: Pain-point discovery with Business Context Mode Selection, Intelligent Defaults, Ambiguity Resolution, Solution Analysis routing.
agents.output: Pain Point Board + Solution Analysis routing

agents.name: AI-PDLC Prioritize
agents.description: Dual scoring frameworks (Agentic vs Application). Source tracking. Re-confirmation loop.

agents.name: AI-PDLC Working Backwards
agents.description: PR/FAQ generation using Amazon Working Backwards. Validates concept with rigorous economics and risk questions.
agents.press_release: 8-part structure (headline, subheading, problem, solution w/ alternatives comparison, leader quote, how it works, customer quote, getting started)

agents.name: AI-PDLC Spec Generator
agents.description: Separate Agentic/Application templates. Produces PROTOTYPE specs + Design Handoff Brief.

agents.name: AI-PDLC Designer
agents.description: Journey maps, wireframes, clickable prototypes — all inside Quick. No external design tools needed.
